headline: Open 5 AM
subtitle: Daily · 116 W MacArthur Blvd · Santa Ana
caption:
5 AM. Every day. Yes, even Sunday.

We open before the rest of MacArthur wakes up. Pan dulce trays, fresh coffee, the usual.

See you at the counter ☀️

headline: Chorizo Burrito
description: Chorizo, eggs, pinto beans, and jack cheese. With hot salsa on the side.
caption:
The chorizo burrito hasn't changed since day one — there's a reason.

Chorizo, eggs, pinto beans, jack cheese, hot salsa on the side. $10.50. Foil-wrapped, ready to go.

Order it #4 at the counter.

headline: If you're up before sunrise, so are we.
caption:
If you're up before sunrise, so are we.

Bakers in by 4 AM, trays out by 5. Pan dulce, coffee, breakfast burritos — already warm by the time most alarms go off.

Stop in this week. ☀️

headline: Pan dulce, fresh.
caption:
Pan dulce arrives before sunrise. Most days they're gone by 10.

Conchas, orejas, polvorones — fresh from this morning's bake.

Save this for your next coffee run.

headline: Still warm
caption:
If you come in by 7, they're still warm.

The whole tray, basically. Conchas, pan dulce, the regulars.

Set the alarm — it's worth it.

headline: Strawberry Milkshake
description: Cold milk, fresh strawberries, sugar, and cinnamon. From the licuados side of the menu.
caption:
Strawberry season is here — the licuados taste like it.

Cold milk, fresh strawberries, sugar, a little cinnamon. $7.50. Side of pan dulce optional but encouraged.

Pair it with the #4 burrito or just sip.

headline: Stop in early.
caption:
5 AM at the bakery looks like this.

Trays loaded, coffee on, the front door's unlocked. 116 W MacArthur Blvd.

Come see what's out today.

headline: Off MacArthur
subtitle: 116 W MacArthur Blvd · Daily 5 – 1
caption:
First stop off the freeway, before MacArthur curves. White door, windmill sign — you can't miss it.

Pan dulce in the case by 5. Burritos hot by 6. Coffee always on.

116 W MacArthur Blvd · Santa Ana ☀️

headline: Ham & Eggs
description: Ham, eggs, pinto beans, and jack cheese. The morning regular.
caption:
Ham, eggs, pinto beans, jack cheese. The #3 burrito on the menu — quiet, dependable, always there.

$10.50. Foil-wrapped, ready to go.

Order it by number at the counter.

headline: Same windmill. Since day one.
caption:
We've changed the paint, swapped the paper bags, broken in three espresso machines. The windmill stays. The pan dulce too.

116 W MacArthur Blvd · Open daily 5 AM

headline: Trays start full.
caption:
By 9, the conchas are usually gone. By 10, most of the pan dulce too.

Set an alarm worth setting.

headline: Orange Juice
description: Cold-pressed, served fresh. Pairs well with a burrito.
caption:
Fresh-pressed orange juice — the cold counter to a hot burrito.

$7.50. Daily. Always cold.

Pair it with the #4 if you want a real morning.

headline: Dough at 4. Doors at 5.
caption:
Bakers in by 4 AM. Trays ready by 5. By the time you order, the conchas have been sitting maybe 30 minutes.

That's the whole point.

headline: Made for the rush.
caption:
Wrapped warm. Easy to grab. Hot salsa on the side.

The morning go-to for everyone running late — and the regulars who plan around it.

headline: The most under-appreciated spot on this list.
attribution: Eater · Best breakfast burritos in OC
caption:
Eater put us on the list — and called Mill Bakery 'the most under-appreciated spot on this list.' Honored.

The chorizo + refried beans they mentioned is the #4. The throwback salchicha & egg is the #9.

Come decide for yourself. Open daily 5 AM.
